rationale: Shiza brings deep robotics and ML expertise from 1X and is now building at the intersection of haptics and applied ML, while Manjot has 15+ years scaling mobile and cross-platform development across 200+ global clients. Manjot's track record shipping iOS/Android solutions and managing technical teams could complement Shiza's hardware-software integration challenges as Haptile scales, and her ML research background could inform solutions for Ajath's vertical AI SaaS and developer tools interests.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Manjot Singh — robotics and haptics expertise meeting 15 years of mobile and cross-platform systems deployment.
